title: GuildWar.eu
description: Fight through the boss-realm of Rungholt with daggers and shortbows, collecting legendary Enderite gear in your mobile backpack. Secure your domain with Guild Claims, forge powerful alliances, and dominate the market in the modern Auction House.
body:
# ⚔️ GuildWar.eu
Welcome to **GuildWar.eu**, a unique Minecraft experience that blends classic survival with deep MMO elements and tactical guild diplomacy. Dive into a world where your combat skills matter just as much as your diplomatic prowess.

## 🏔️ Explore Rungholt & The End
Venture off the beaten path and enter **Rungholt**, our custom-crafted PvE map. Battle unique creatures like Forest Wolves and Corrupted Harvest Spirits, or face epic boss encounters against **Arachna the Webweaver** and the legendary wolf **Fenris**. Even the End holds new dangers: the Ender Dragon awaits you with 600 HP, guarding the precious Enderite Crystals.

## 🗡️ Revolutionary Combat & Gear
Forget standard PvP! We’ve introduced new weapon classes to redefine your playstyle:
- **Daggers:** No attack cooldown, but limited reach – perfect for swift assassins.
- **Shortbows:** No draw time! Fire arrows instantly and dominate the battlefield from a distance.
- **Legendary Sets:** Forge **Hardened Iron Armor** for maximum defense or hunt down the ultimate **Enderite Set**.

## 🎒 Quality of Life:
No more Shulker frustration! With our **Backpacks**, your mobile inventory is always with you—even in areas where placing chests is prohibited. Use **Quivers** for your arrows and specialized **Hunting Bags** to efficiently store the massive amounts of loot from Rungholt.

## 🏰 Guilds, Claims & Alliances
Found a Guild and secure your territory using our Chunk-Claim system.
- **Growth:** Start with 6 chunks and expand your empire up to 128 chunks.
- **Diplomacy:** Use the Alliance System to build with friendly guilds, share resources, and protect each other from harm.

## 💰 Thriving Economy & Magic
- **Auction House:** Trade securely and efficiently with other players via our modern Global Auction House.
- **Merlin the Archmage:** Purchase exclusive custom enchantments like **"Smelter"** (auto-smelt ores) or **"Regeneration."**
- **Daily Quests:** Visit Hunter Johan for your daily dose of adventure and rewards.
